title: Verification Gauntlet
prompt: Implement the run-length codec (module-14 contract) AND the reversed-word validator: `isReversedPair(a, b)` is true iff b is a with all characters in reverse order (single characters and empty strings are trivially pairs). The mutation suite probes boundaries: empty, single-char, palindromes, repeated chars.

tests.name: codec round-trip over input classes
tests.hint: encode runs; decode splits on ',' then expands count x value. Round-trip holds for every class.

tests.name: reversed-pair boundary battery
tests.hint: Compare a[i] with b[a.size()-1-i] for all i — length mismatch first. Note "aab"/"baa" IS a pair, "aa"/"aa" is too (palindrome).
